acceptanceCriteria: a partial-clone fixture shows every Core and MCP read refuses a missing promisor object with a coded envelope and performs no fetch (GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH or equivalent), with a regression test
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from PR #229 (panel B5) deferral. In a partial clone a blob the read needs may be missing locally. The Core refusal envelope has no code for this case, and the panel inferred that corvint.flows.* cat-file blob reads lazily fetch from the promisor remote and write .git/objects, against invariant 4 and MCPV0-017 (no fetch or network from read tools). The lazy-fetch outcome is inferred from Git's documented behaviour; confirm with a partial-clone fixture.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#698 (merge 8388456d); focused tests, doc gates, dogfood bind/check/seal and independent review passed; evidence is the sha256 of the lane and batch build-logs at the merge commit.

title: partial clone: missing promisor objects are unclassified and flows reads can lazy-fetch
